An analysis of shows that 46.27% of the queries have a sequence level reward of and are thus completely correct.
We see that the B2S model outperforms the baseline model by a large margin, yielding an increase in F1 score by 6.24 points.

edges.sentence: We use the settings of [Sennrich et al. 2017], where an input sequence x = x_1, x_2, … x_|x| (a natural language question) is encoded by a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), each input token has an associated hidden vector h_i = [h_i; h_i] where the former is created by a forward pass over the input, and the latter by a backward pass. h_i is obtained by recursively computing f(x_i, h_i-1) where f is a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) [Chung et al. 2014], and h_i is computed analogously.
